title: Kerzenlicht
failed: The flashlight did not start. See the Noctalia log
unsupported: This compositor cannot tell Kerzenlicht where the cursor is (missing {protocols})

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: The glow around the cursor at full strength, in logical pixels

softness.label: Soft edge
softness.description: How many pixels the glow takes to fade out

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.description: How strong the white glow is, from 0.1 (a hint) to 1 (solid white, covering what is under it)

also_dnd.label: Also Do Not Disturb
also_dnd.description: Turn Do Not Disturb on with the flashlight, and put it back the way it was afterwards
